peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.4% below its local comparables; 28 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (43.1): 4.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 22 of 51 similar developments. Context, not scored: resales in 70.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,840,000 ($2,003 psf, 861–1,001 sq ft; 6 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,032 psf (range $1,822–2,474); 1.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $27,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $2,680,000 ($2,141 psf, 1,237–1,539 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,129 psf (range $1,933–2,483); 0.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $15,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Harbourfront MRT about 380 m, Telok Blangah MRT about 930 m; closer than 9 of 51 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 1 within 2 km; nearest Blangah Rise Primary School about 1,430 m; more than 0 of 51 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 440 m), more than 6 of 51 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre Telok Blangah Rise Market about 920 m; nearest park Mount Faber Park about 370 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 12 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 184 resales (184 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (21) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Telok Blangah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 570 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 184 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 1 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 184 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 222 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−17.1%). Planning-area private resales −18%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
